pairs.why: Both are nearly the same windmill with the same clouds and wheat finish, so I can't see a difference that matters for the style.
Both are nearly the same render with soft clouds and the same wheat texture, so neither reads closer to the real cards.
A has the soft puffy clouds the real lighthouse card has, while B's sky is empty and flat; the windmill itself is the same in both.
B has the soft puffy clouds the real sky cards use, while A's plain gradient sky looks emptier; the object is the same in both.
A's sky has puffy clouds like the real lighthouse card, while B's is a plain gradient; the windmill build and finish are the same.
B has the soft clouds and the lighter, layered sky of the real cards, while A's sky is empty; otherwise they match.
A has the soft clouds that match the real sky cards, while B's sky is bare; the tower and wheat are the same.
B's puffy clouds match the real lighthouse card's sky better than A's bare gradient; the rendering is otherwise the same.
